faq.q: How far is Starlite from Puerto Banús?
faq.a: Starlite 2049 is held at the Auditorio Starlite in the Cantera de Nagüeles, about 15 minutes by car from Puerto Banús. A pre-concert yacht charter from our base lets you enjoy the sea, then take a short taxi or private transfer to the venue. Plan to disembark by 19:30 to reach the show comfortably.

faq.q: What is included in a Starlite pre-concert yacht charter?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). For a special evening, you can add champagne or a custom canapé menu. The Mangusta 80 also includes a jet ski for free.

faq.q: Can I book a yacht for just a few hours before the concert?
faq.a: Yes. Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39) are perfect for a 2-hour cruise, costing €749 for two hours or €2,299 for eight hours. For a pre-concert sail, 2–3 hours is ideal, giving you time to relax, swim, and still arrive at Starlite on time.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a group going to Starlite?
faq.a: For groups of up to 9, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m) is great. For up to 11, the Azimut 39 (12.5m) works well. If you want more space and a jet ski, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) is a luxurious option. All depart from Puerto Banús, close to the festival.

faq.q: Do you provide transfers from the marina to Starlite?
faq.a: Transfers are not included in the charter, but we can arrange a private taxi or minibus from Puerto Banús to the Auditorio Starlite on request. The drive is about 15 minutes. Many guests choose to walk to the nearby port exit and grab a taxi — it's simple and quick.

faq.q: What time should I book my charter for a Starlite concert?
faq.a: Most concerts start around 21:00, so we recommend a charter from 16:00 to 19:00 or 17:00 to 20:00. This gives you 2–3 hours at sea, time to shower or freshen up at the marina, and a relaxed transfer to the venue. If you want a longer day, the 8-hour option works too.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food or drinks on board?
faq.a: We provide a selection of drinks and light snacks, but you're welcome to bring your own food, especially if you have dietary preferences. For a pre-concert treat, many guests bring a cake or gourmet bites. Just avoid glass bottles where possible — we'll handle the rest.

faq.q: Is there a minimum booking time for the Mangusta 80?
faq.a: Yes, the Mangusta 80 (and its grey variant) has a minimum charter of 4 hours, priced at €4,719. That includes the free jet ski. For a Starlite pre-concert, a 4-hour cruise from 15:00 to 19:00 works perfectly, giving you plenty of time to enjoy the sea and still make the show.

data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella yacht charter for Starlite 2049 is the smartest way to turn a concert night into a full Mediterranean experience. Instead of rushing from a hotel to the Auditorio Starlite, you can spend the late afternoon cruising the coast from Puerto Banús, sipping cava, swimming in a calm cove, and then arriving at the venue relaxed and ready for the show. With boats departing right from Puerto Banús — just 15 minutes from the festival — the logistics are simple. Here's how to plan your pre-concert cruise without the stress.

Why a Pre-Concert Charter Works

Starlite 2049 is Marbella's most anticipated summer event, held in a natural amphitheatre at the Cantera de Nagüeles. The venue sits inland, but the best way to start the evening is on the water. A 2–3 hour charter lets you watch the sun drop behind La Concha, anchor near Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for a quick swim, and then dock back at Puerto Banús with time to spare. You'll avoid traffic, enjoy a unique perspective of the coast, and set a sophisticated tone for the night ahead.

Boat Options for Your Starlite Evening

We have a fleet of 17 boats, all departing from Puerto Banús. For a pre-concert charter, the most popular choices are:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) — €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests) — same pricing as the Astondoa, ideal for slightly larger groups.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, up to 12 guests) — €4,719 for a 4-hour minimum, includes a free jet ski for extra fun.

All other boats, from the Ferretti 94 to the Lagoon 380, are available on request via WhatsApp — we'll tailor a package to your group size and budget.

What's Included in Every Charter

No hidden costs. Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). That means the price you see is the price you pay. For a special occasion, you can add champagne, a gourmet tapas spread, or even a private chef — just let us know when you book.

Sample Itinerary: 16:00 – 19:00

Here's a typical pre-concert schedule that works for a 21:00 Starlite show:

  • 16:00 — Board at Puerto Banús, meet your skipper, and settle in.
  • 16:15 — Cruise east towards Cabopino or west towards Estepona, depending on wind and your preference.
  • 17:00 — Anchor at a quiet cove like Cala del Faro for a swim and snorkel.
  • 18:00 — Enjoy drinks and snacks on deck while the sun starts to lower.
  • 18:45 — Head back to Puerto Banús, enjoying the golden-hour views of La Concha.
  • 19:00 — Disembark, freshen up at the marina (or your hotel), and take a 15-minute taxi to Starlite.

How to Get to Starlite from Puerto Banús

After your charter, you'll need to get to the Auditorio Starlite. The venue is about 6 km from Puerto Banús, roughly a 15-minute drive. Taxis are available at the marina, or we can arrange a private transfer for your group. If you're staying on the Golden Mile, you might even walk from your hotel — but a taxi is easiest after a day on the water.

Book Early — Starlite Dates Fill Fast

Starlite 2049 is a highlight of the Marbella summer, and our boats book out quickly on concert nights. We recommend reserving at least 2–3 weeks in advance, especially for headline acts. To secure your preferred boat and time, message us on WhatsApp with your date, group size, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability and pricing within hours.
